name: Banyan Tree Shanghai On The Bund

address.street: 19 Gong Ping Road Hongkou District Shanghai

insider_take: This ultra-luxe sanctuary sits majestically on the historic Bund, where Shanghai's colonial past meets its glittering future in perfect harmony.
whats_special: Located in the prestigious North Bund financial district, this Banyan Tree occupies floors 47-73 of Shanghai's tallest building. The hotel features Asia's highest urban spa and offers unparalleled 360-degree views of the Huangpu River, iconic Bund waterfront, and futuristic Lujiazui skyline. Each suite boasts floor-to-ceiling windows and private terraces overlooking the city's most coveted vistas.
pro_tip: Book a river-facing suite for sunset cocktails with front-row seats to the nightly light show that illuminates the Bund's Art Deco facades and Pudong's towering skyscrapers.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature spa treatments while gazing out at the city below, and evening strolls along the Bund Promenade just minutes away, where you can experience Shanghai's most famous architectural showcase spanning neoclassical buildings from the 1920s-1940s alongside cutting-edge modern towers across the river.
pros: Prime Bund waterfront location with stunning Huangpu River views
Luxurious spa services and wellness facilities
Sophisticated design blending modern luxury with Asian aesthetics
Premium dining options with panoramic city skyline views
cons: Busy tourist area with high foot traffic
